en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
New Content:
[+] Added four accessories that can restore magicules and aura. See the corresponding item descriptions in the quest book for details.
[+] Added a new guild, the Free Guild, and the neutral boss Yuuki.
[+] Players can accept and complete 3 tasks from the dwarf to unlock story dialogue. The dwarf will then give the player a map to the guild.
[+] After joining the guild, players can accept various subjugation and collection quests to earn adventurer experience and rewards.
[+] Added a new Spirit Enhancement skill, which grants pets bonus attributes equal to 35% of the player's current attack damage and maximum health.
[+] Added several new biomes, including End and Nether biomes.
[+] Added a new boss, the Cult of Azazel, in the Nether.
[+] Updated the mysticism mod. The Worm race makes a strong return.
[+] Added new quest points and adjusted quest book sections.
Adjustments & Optimizations:
[+] Adjusted mob drops. Sophisticated Backpacks will no longer drop from other mobs.
[+] Resistance skills can no longer be locked.
[+] Optimized and adjusted the Spirit Summon skill.
[+] After a failed summon, players will be returned directly to the summon options.
[+] The magicule cost of summoning is now 50% of the corresponding creature's magicules.
[+] Updated NeoForge to version 224.
Fixes:
[+] Attempted to fix an issue where players could become the Fallen Angel race when the host used a Reset Scroll. This is a LAN-only bug.
[+] Fixed a crash issue.
[+] Fixed an issue with the Uriel skill.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
新增内容：
[+] 添加四种可恢复魔素和斗气的饰品，具体详情请查看任务书中对应物品的介绍。
[+] 添加新公会“自由公会”与中立Boss优树。
[+] 玩家可以在矮人处接取并完成3个任务，随后解锁剧情对话，矮人会给予玩家前往自由公会的地图。
[+] 加入公会后，可接取各种讨伐/收集任务，获取冒险经验和奖励。
[+] 新增“灵之强化”技能，会将玩家当前攻击力与最大生命值的35%作为额外属性赋予宠物。
[+] 新增一些群系，包括末地和下界群系。
[+] 新增Boss阿撒兹勒教团，位于下界。
[+] 更新mysticism模组，蠕虫种族“强势”回归。
[+] 调整任务书板块，并新增一些任务点。
调整与优化：
[+] 修改生物掉落，精妙背包将不再从其他生物身上掉落。
[+] 抗性技能将不再支持“锁定”。
[+] 优化并修改“灵之召唤”技能机制。
[+] 召唤失败后，将直接返回“召唤选项”。
[+] 召唤消耗的魔素为对应生物魔素的50%。
[+] NeoForge版本更新至224。
修复内容：
[+] 尝试修复房主使用重置卷导致玩家变成堕天使种族的问题。此问题仅为局域网联机Bug。
[+] 修复一处崩溃问题。
[+] 修复乌列尔技能的一个问题。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
